IsAllowed.issue: MECHANISM: RelicModel.IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest (RelicModel.cs:452-456) is `runState.TotalFloor < 41` in single-player, i.e. the relic stops spawning from the Act 3 treasure chest onward. The sim's Relic base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py) declares NO is_allowed member at all, and relic_pools.populate_relic_grab_bags shuffles the whole transcribed pool once at run init with no per-pull eligibility filter, so the relic stays pullable for the entire run. REACHABILITY (LIVE): the relic is in the transcribed shared pool, the sim tracks RunState.total_floor already (event gates use it), and runs reach floor 41. The observable is pool composition -- a late pull hands out a relic the game would have filtered, which also shifts every subsequent pull. CLUSTER (executed: py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-isallowed): TWENTY ported relics override IsAllowed and SIXTEEN share this exact gate -- amethyst_aubergine, book_of_five_rings, bowler_hat, dragon_fruit, frozen_egg, girya, juzu_bracelet, lucky_fysh, meal_ticket, molten_egg, old_coin, planisphere, shovel, toxic_egg, white_beast_statue, white_star. One base-class member plus one filter in the pull path closes all sixteen; see .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md.

ModifyGoldGained.maps_to: no counterpart; Relic.modify_gold_gained (relics/base.py:212) is the hook it would map to, and the sim's port implements nothing at all
ModifyGoldGained.issue: MECHANISM: BowlerHat.cs:18-25 multiplies every gold gain by DynamicVar('GoldIncrease', 1.25m).BaseValue. The sim registers the relic as a behaviourless stub whose docstring says 'out-of-combat only (no gold system), stub' -- and that premise is FALSE. RunState has gold, RunState.gain_gold (run.py:325-333) is the grant path, and it already runs the modify_gold_gained chain over the run's relics -- the exact hook this port needs. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes.py batch2): gain_gold(100) grants +100 both with and without the relic, where C# grants +125. The relic is Uncommon in the transcribed shared grab bag (relic_pools.py:'RELIC.BOWLER_HAT') and every combat reward screen pays gold. CLUSTER: one of 30 behaviourless ports whose dropped hooks all have a live dispatch site -- py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-stub-premises.

AfterModifyingGoldGained.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N1: the multiplier is 1.25m DECIMAL and gold is an integer quantity -- rounding is unspecified by this file
guards.issue: C# multiplies in decimal and the result flows into PlayerCmd's gold path; the sim's gain_gold takes a float (run.py:325) and RunState.gold is an int. A fix that writes `int(amount * 1.25)` picks a rounding rule this record cannot confirm, and a 1-gold drift compounds across a run and is visible to the conformance gold check. Flagged so the fix settles the rounding against the C# gold-gain path rather than guessing; carries ModifyGoldGained's LIVE label because it is part of the same unported body. NOTE per binding rule 7: settling it needs PlayerCmd.cs / the gold path, which this record does not hash.

guards.rationale: The `player != base.Owner` / `shuffler == base.Owner` / `cardPlay.Card.Owner != base.Owner` family is the multiplayer per-player filter on a hook the game dispatches for every player. The sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one PlayerCombatState), so the filter is structurally satisfied. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract.
